## Personality

A capable, managing, and hardworking individual, Rachel Lynde is known as a kind soul who never shirks her share of work. However, she is also a critical, outspoken, and meddlesome gossip who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor, to the point that she would pick faults in the Angel Gabriel himself. Additionally, she is a red-hot, enthusiastic politician, dearly loves to be asked for advice, and firmly opposes higher education for women, believing it unfits them for woman's true sphere.

## History

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) is a prominent [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) housekeeper who raised ten children and knitted sixteen cotton warp quilts. Her curiosity was piqued when she learned the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) were adopting an orphan, and she was later insulted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), though she quickly accepted Anne's dramatic apology. Over time, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) became a source of advice for [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), suggesting how to handle Anne's school troubles and attending political events with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel initially clashed with [Anne](../character/anne.md) after visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and rudely criticizing her physical appearance, sparking an explosive argument between the two. However, their relationship quickly smoothed over when [Anne](../character/anne.md) offered a dramatically thorough apology, prompting Rachel to forgive her and offer encouraging words about her hair. Over time, Rachel shifts from a harsh critic to someone who takes an interest in Anne's upbringing, even offering [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) practical counsel on how to manage the girl's temperamental behavior.

- Enemy of — insulted Anne and faced intense mutual hostility  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintain a longstanding neighborly friendship built on open conversation and mutual trust. Rachel frequently visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss local news, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels comfortable seeking her practical advice, such as how to handle Anne's refusal to attend school. Though Rachel is not above offering strong warnings or disapproval—such as when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) first decided to adopt an orphan—the two women remain close companions who attend events like political rallies together.

- Friend of — longstanding neighborly friendship  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P40](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0040)</sub>

### [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

[Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) is Rachel's husband, living with her in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). While Rachel manages their household affairs and keeps close tabs on the community's happenings, [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) occasionally travels with her to events outside the area, such as a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown).

- Spouse of — husband  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)</sub>
